visual_identity.core_identity: A flowing mass of ordinary rats whose individual bodies remain readable while the group moves like a living tide.
visual_identity.silhouette: Many low rat bodies overlap in a directional stream, with tails and pointed snouts creating flow without becoming a black mass.
visual_identity.head_features: Repeated simple rat heads with pointed snouts, rounded ears, whiskers, and occasional visible incisors.
visual_identity.body_shape: Small four-legged rodent forms in varied running poses; no giant leader rat.
visual_identity.surface: Minimal fur lines and simple mostly hairless tails.
